The library has not only a collection of current books but also has assorted newspapers, magazines and print journals. ### Collections ### Library Quick Links * Library Mission & Vision * Library Services * Collections * Library FAQ’s Image The library provides access to an extensive collection of books, periodicals (magazines and journals), audio-visual material and electronic databases and journals. The overall stock stands at 25000 volumes. The stock consists of multiple copies of recommended and prescribed materials.​​ ### Audio Visual & CD-ROM Collection The library has more than 3000 audio- visual, CD-ROMs and DVD-ROMs. These are available in the multimedia center where workstations are provided for listening and watching. ### Electronic Resources The Martin Oduor-Otieno Library subscribes to subject databases and e-journals. Access to these resources is possible from any computer with an internet connection at KCA University. Electronic Databases & Journals provides access to unique groups of high quality peer-reviewed journals in specific disciplines, ensuring the information is directly relevant to your interest area. With these a customer has access to over a million full text peer reviewed articles that are current and well researched. For example, Emerald Database has more than 75000 full text articles.​ ### Main Collection These are collection of books that are on ground, first and second floors. Those on ground floor are ‘Short Loan’ books issued for shorter period and those in the other floors are ‘Long loan’ books issued for longer periods. ### Past Examination Papers All the past examination papers are available through the E-learning system (MOODLE). All you need is to have your personal log-in details and be a currently registered student or staff member. ### Periodicals (Journals & Magazines) The library has not only a collection of current books but also has assorted newspapers, magazines and print journals. In addition, the library has newspaper reader tables, displayer and holders that make reading newspaper fun. ### Reference Collection The library has a wide range of reference collections that include dictionaries, encyclopedias, and subject-specific books among others. These books are normally marked with the Prefix REF and/or have red labels on the spine. This category of books is found on the ground floor. ### Opening Hours Main Campus: Monday – Friday | 7:30 AM – 8:30 PM Saturday | 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM Sunday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Campus Opening Hours -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Library (https://spu.ac.ke/index.php/library) 【turn352search1】 [wordlim: 200] Published: 1.2 years ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; Our library is more than just a collection of books; it is a dynamic and supportive hub for learning, research, and collaboration. ... E-Book | Repository | Journals & Database | Catalogue | Open Access Database ### THE UNIVERSITY LIBRARY Welcome to the heart of academic life at St. Paul's University. Our library is more than just a collection of books; it is a dynamic and supportive hub for learning, research, and collaboration. We are dedicated to providing the comprehensive resources, expert guidance, and modern facilities you need to excel in your studies and scholarly pursuits. #### Library Services My Account Library FAQs Library Services Off Campus Access MyLOFT #### Information Literacy Zotero Guide APA Referencing Guide Instructors Turn-it-in Manual Students Turn-it-in User Manual ### Vast Digital Literacy We provide access to a rich and diverse range of materials to support your academic journey. Through the university's online portal, you have 24/7 access to a world of information. E-Book | Repository | Journals & Database | Catalogue | Open Access Database ### LIBRARY SERVICES FOR YOUR SUCCESS Our professional library staff are here to provide the support and training you need to thrive academically. RESEARCH SUPPORT Our subject librarians are available for one-on-one consultations to help you develop research strategies, navigate complex databases, and find the exact information you need for your assignments. INFORMATION LITERACY TRAINING We regularly host workshops designed to enhance your academic skills. Popular topics include advanced search techniques, proper citation and referencing  and avoiding plagiarism. BORROWING & CIRCULATION We also offer inter-library loan services to source materials from partner institutions when needed. FACILITIES & TECHNOLOGY The library offers a variety of modern facilities, including: Quiet individual study carrels, collaborative group study rooms, fully equipped computer labs with high-speed internet, printing, scanning, and photocopying services. ### Extensive Physical Collection Our shelves house a carefully curated collection of materials supporting all university curricula, including: * Core Textbooks & Reference Materials: Essential reading for all courses offered at SPU. * Academic Journals & Periodicals: Stay current with the latest research and discourse in your field. * Special Collections: Unique and valuable resources, including theological texts and historical university publications. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Print Collections - Meru University - Library (https://library.must.ac.ke/print-collections/) 【turn352search2】 [wordlim: 200] Published: 13.0 years ago; Crawled: last month; The Library caters to the different needs of its clients through provision of a wide range of materials in its collection that is well beyond 30,000 volumes of print materials. ... These are books you can access from the open shelves in the library. # Print Collections Print Collections The Library caters to the different needs of its clients through provision of a wide range of materials in its collection that is well beyond 30,000 volumes of print materials. These comprise of relevant and current books, journals, theses and dissertations.   ## Categories 1. Open Shelves These are books you can access from the open shelves in the library. You are allowed to read them within the library or borrow to use while you are away. 2. Short loan books These are usually, books that are highly in demand but only a few copies are available. To make them used by as many people as possible, the library withdraws a copy or two from the open shelves and keeps them on a special shelve behind the library’s service desk. You can still view these items when searching the library’s catalog. You will however, need to request for it at the library’s service desk. These items can be borrowed for a period of 3 hours or overnight during which they must be returned early in the morning. 3.
